findings.entity: Foreground dancer, mirror baseboard, and studio floor
findings.description: The rectangular region around the foreground dancer is horizontally flipped in place for a brief interval at 00:02 before reverting at 00:03. This breaks the room's geometry: the diagonal wooden baseboard of the mirror wall disappears to the left of the dancer's legs, appears angled in the opposite direction beneath her right hand, and terminates at a sharp vertical seam to the right of her right leg where the true baseboard resumes. The floorboards beneath her feet also reverse left-to-right (moving the dark plank from under her left foot to under her right foot), and the dancer's pose becomes geometrically incompatible with her mirror reflection (her left arm on the door side is raised straight up, while her reflection in the mirror has the arm on the opposite barre side raised).
